svg.aria-label: The red/blue lifecycle: 1 research, each side studies its field (v0.3); 2 build typed, versioned attack and defense artifacts (v0.2); 3 execute the target behind the gateway, attacks enter only untrusted surfaces and every tool call is checked (partly in v0.1, sandbox in v0.2); 4 verify from the record (in v0.1); 5 dream, each side consolidates verified lessons between epochs with operator approval (v0.4); 6 evaluate on sealed holdouts with preregistered thresholds (v0.5).
